name: GitHub Event Router
description: Claims GitHub Slack app posts in the GitHub feed channel and writes one queue file per issue or pull request event for issue-worker-bots and pr-review-bots. Posts that contain @openclaw go to the normal agent turn.

channelId.description: Slack channel id of the GitHub feed (default C0CEMPH1L0N).

queueRoot.description: Absolute directory that holds the iwb/ and prbot/ queues (default ~/.local/state/github-events).

botSenderIds.description: Slack sender ids of the GitHub app. Only these are queued. Empty (the default) queues nothing; other bot posts are claimed without queueing and logged as 'unknown bot sender <id>'.
